sentences.text: Election is a 1999 American black comedy-drama film directed and written by Alexander Payne and adapted by him and Jim Taylor from Tom Perrotta 's 1998 novel of the same title .	Alexander Payne	Alexander Payne	Jim Taylor	Jim Taylor (writer)	Election	Election (1998 novel)	Tom Perrotta	Tom Perrotta	black	Black comedy	comedy-drama film	Comedy-drama	novel of the same title	Election (1998 novel)
The plot revolves around a high school election and satirizes both suburban high school life and politics .

The film stars Matthew Broderick as Jim McAllister , a popular high school social studies teacher in suburban Omaha , Nebraska , and Reese Witherspoon as Tracy Flick , around the time of the school 's student body election .	Matthew Broderick	Matthew Broderick	Reese Witherspoon	Reese Witherspoon	Tracy Flick	Tracy Flick	student body	Student governments in the United States
When Tracy qualifies to run for class president , McAllister believes she does not deserve the title and tries his best to stop her from winning .
Although a box office bomb , Election received critical acclaim .	Election	Election (1998 novel)	box office bomb	box office bomb

The film received an Academy Award nomination for Best Adapted Screenplay , a Golden Globe nomination for Witherspoon in the Best Actress category , and the Independent Spirit Award for Best Film in 1999 .
